speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: To realize this, you have to actually go back to first principles and build a complete software stack with portability, performance, and programmability in mind.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: We've built all our kernels underneath the hood that are built on top of Mojo.
zh: 我们在底层构建了所有的 kernel，它们都构建在 Mojo 之上。

speaker: Unknown
en: Finally, today's AI inference is distributed.
zh: 最后，如今的 AI 推理是分布式的。

speaker: Unknown
en: So you actually need a cloud solution as well.
zh: 所以你实际上还需要一个云解决方案。

speaker: Unknown
en: You need to pick which hardware to deploy your model on, how to route different user requests to different machines, how to do KVCache offloading and distributed inference and disaggregated inference to be able to serve the model at the speed and the cost that folks expect.
zh: 你需要选择将模型部署在哪种硬件上，如何把不同的用户请求路由到不同的机器，如何做 KVCache 卸载、分布式推理和分离式推理，才能以人们期望的速度和成本来服务模型。

speaker: Unknown
en: So putting it all together, we built a modular platform.
zh: 把这些整合在一起，我们构建了 modular 平台。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's fully programmable.
zh: 它是完全可编程的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's hardware abstracted.
zh: 它是硬件抽象化的。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's SodaPerf.

speaker: Unknown
en: And then it actually can be deployed both on-prem as well as on our cloud as well.

speaker: Unknown
en: So it could be, if you have a cloud setup, you can actually download the modular cloud and deploy it there.

speaker: Unknown
en: So let me kind of dig into each one at a time, each part of the stack.
zh: 那么让我逐一深入介绍技术栈的每个部分。

speaker: Unknown
en: So the first is Mojo.

speaker: Unknown
en: So Mojo, as I mentioned, is a Pythonic system programming language.
zh: 正如我提到的，Mojo 是一种类 Python 的系统编程语言。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's not unlike C++, Rust, or CUDA C++.
zh: 它和 C++、Rust 或 CUDA C++ 没有太大不同。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: It's blazing fast.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: And you can think of it as the best way to program CPUs and GPUs within a Python-like programming language.

speaker: Unknown
en: In terms of how we think about Mojo, you know, you can think about, there's three different quadrants, usability, performance, and portability.
zh: 至于我们如何看待 Mojo，你可以这样想，有三个不同的象限：易用性、性能和可移植性。

speaker: Unknown
en: Rockham and CUDA gives you massive performance, but they sacrifice on both usability and programmability.
zh: Rockham 和 CUDA 给你极致的性能，但它们在易用性和可编程性上都有牺牲。

speaker: Unknown
en: A lot of folks use agents to actually program these systems nowadays.
zh: 如今很多人实际上使用智能体来为这些系统编程。

speaker: Unknown
en: OpenCL, back a few years ago, was popular.
zh: OpenCL 几年前曾经流行过。

speaker: Unknown
en: It gives you great portability, but it's sacrificed on performance and usability.
zh: 它给了你很好的可移植性，但在性能和易用性上有所牺牲。

speaker: Unknown
en: Triton has a good sweet spot that gives you 70% of the perf, but it gives you portability and usability.
zh: Triton 有一个不错的平衡点，能给你 70% 的性能，同时提供可移植性和易用性。

speaker: Unknown
en: And Mojo is trying to kind of fill the niche of the sweet spot where it's the best of both worlds.
zh: 而 Mojo 试图填补的正是这个最佳平衡点的生态位，做到两全其美。

speaker: Unknown
en: It gives you the abstraction to allow you to write portable kernels and usable kernels while giving you also the low-level access to get the maximum performance.
zh: 它给你抽象能力，让你能编写可移植且易用的 kernel，同时给你底层访问权限以获得最大性能。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've actually open sourced practically all of our kernels.

speaker: Unknown
en: So you can actually test this stuff.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can benchmark it on your own machine.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So Max is trying to kind of solve a few of the assumptions that were made back in the day for PyTorch.
zh: Max 试图解决的是当年 PyTorch 所做的一些假设。

speaker: Unknown
en: PyTorch is about 10 years old.
zh: PyTorch 大约有 10 年历史了。

speaker: Unknown
en: It was not really designed for the Gen.AI inference of today.
zh: 它并不是真正为今天的 Gen.AI 推理而设计的。

speaker: Unknown
en: As a result, you have like VLM and SGLang that stepped into the void to give you things like KVCache, page attention, and things like that.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

zh: 再说一次，它从零开始构建，采用了最好的技术、最先进的图编译器、eager 模式执行，可跨设备移植，它理解你的 mojo 程序以实现新颖的融合，并为你提供在常规 PyTorch 中无法达到的最大性能和可部署性。

speaker: Unknown
en: So compared to other stacks, this is a single stack that allows you to serve, develop the model, as well as optimize everything in one cohesive system.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: You can build a model as you expect.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can import modules.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
